title: Reporting passive and causative have/get · 报道型被动与使役结构
pattern: It is said that + clause  ·  Subject + is said to + V  ·  have + object + past participle
summary: 报道型被动用于转述“据说、据信”；have / get + 宾语 + 过去分词表示“请别人做某事”。
explanation: **报道型被动**用来转述“人们普遍认为、据说、据报道”的信息。常见动词有 say、believe、think、know、report、expect、consider 等。结构有两种：**It is said that + 从句**，如 It is said that the old bridge was built by a famous architect.（据说这座老桥是一位著名建筑师建造的。）以及 **主语 + is said to + 动词**，如 He is said to be the best chef in the city.（据说他是城里最好的厨师。）

**to 不定式的时态要跟随说话的时间**。讲现在或将来的事，用 to + 动词原形：He is said **to live** in Paris.；讲过去的事，用 to have + 过去分词：He is said **to have lived** in Paris for ten years.（据说他在巴黎住过十年。）中文“据说他曾经……”的时间感，英语要通过 to have + 过去分词来表达。

**使役结构 have / get + 宾语 + 过去分词** 表示“请别人做某事，自己是安排者，而不是动作的执行者”：I had my hair **cut**.（我请人剪了头发。）We had the roof **repaired** after the storm.（暴风雨后，我们请人修了屋顶。）get 也可以这样用，语气更口语化：I'll get the car **serviced** next week.
要区分 have something done 和 have someone do：前者是“让别人做某事（事情本身是被动的）”，后者是“让某人去做某事（人是执行者）”，例如 She had her son **clean** the room.（她让儿子打扫房间。）中文“请人做”常常不分这两种，英语却要严格区分。
注意：如果主语是 he、she 这样的人，报道型被动一般不能直接说 He is said that…，而要写成 It is said that… 或 He is said to…。使役结构中，宾语和过去分词之间是被动关系，所以不能用主动形式 have my hair cutting。
mistakes: ✗ He is said that he is rich. → ✓ It is said that he is rich. / He is said to be rich. 主语 he 不能直接放在 is said 后面接 that 从句；应使用 It is said that 或 He is said to…。
✗ He is said to has moved to Canada. → ✓ He is said to have moved to Canada. 讲过去的事要用 to have + 过去分词，不用 to has。
✗ I had the car wash yesterday. → ✓ I had the car washed yesterday. 中文“请人洗车”是使役，车被洗，所以要用过去分词 washed。
✗ I had my hair cutted yesterday. → ✓ I had my hair cut yesterday. cut 是不规则动词，过去分词仍是 cut，不能加 -ted。

examples.text: It is said that the old bridge was built by a famous architect.
examples.translation: 据说这座老桥是一位著名建筑师建造的。

examples.text: He is said to be the best chef in the city.
examples.translation: 据说他是城里最好的厨师。

examples.text: The workers are believed to have left the country last year.
examples.translation: 据信这些工人去年已经离开了这个国家。
examples.note: 讲过去的事，用 to have + 过去分词。

examples.text: We had the roof repaired after the storm.
examples.translation: 暴风雨过后，我们请人修了屋顶。

examples.text: I'd like to have my photo taken in front of the castle.
examples.translation: 我想请人在城堡前给我拍张照。

examples.text: She had her son clean the room before dinner.
examples.translation: 晚饭前，她让儿子打扫房间。
examples.note: have + 人 + 动词原形：人是执行者。

examples.text: The manager had the staff trained in customer service.
examples.translation: 经理安排员工接受了客户服务培训。

exercises.sentence: He is said ___ in Paris for ten years.
exercises.translation: 据说他在巴黎住过十年。
options: to have live
to have lived
lived
living
exercises.explanation: 讲过去的事用 to have + 过去分词 lived。

exercises.sentence: I want to have my hair ___ before the wedding.
exercises.translation: 我想在婚礼前请人剪个头发。
options: cut
to cut
cutting
cuts
exercises.explanation: have + 宾语 + 过去分词：头发被剪，所以用 cut。

exercises.sentence: It ___ that the new bridge will open next spring.
exercises.translation: 据说这座新桥明年春天开通。
options: says
is said
is said to
said
exercises.explanation: It is said that + 从句 是报道型被动的标准结构。

exercises.source: 据说他年轻时是一名优秀的运动员。
options: It is said that he is a talented athlete when he was young.
He says to have been a talented athlete when he was young.
He is said to be a talented athlete when he was young.
He is said to have been a talented athlete when he was young.
exercises.explanation: “年轻时”是过去，所以用 is said to have been。

exercises.source: 我下周要请人给车做保养。
options: I am going to have my car service next week.
I am going to have my car serviced by yesterday.
I am going to have my car serviced next week.
I am going to service my car next week.
exercises.explanation: “请人做保养”用 have + 宾语 + 过去分词 serviced；service my car 表示自己动手。

exercises.source: 我想请人在城堡前给我拍张照。
options: I'd like to have my photo take in front of the castle.
I'd like to have my photo taken in front of the castle.
I'd like to get my photo to take in front of the castle.
I'd like to take my photo in front of the castle.
exercises.explanation: 照片被拍，要用过去分词 taken；take my photo 表示自己拍。

options: It is believed that the treasure is hidden in the mountains.
He is believed to be lost in the forest.
He is believed that to be lost in the forest.
exercises.explanation: 主语 he 不能和 that 从句这样连用，应写成 He is believed to be lost in the forest。

options: I had my hair cutted yesterday.
I had my hair cut yesterday.
She had her bag stolen on the bus.
exercises.explanation: cut 是不规则动词，过去分词仍是 cut，应写成 I had my hair cut yesterday。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 据说博物馆下个月将重新开放。
exercises.explanation: 报道型被动 It is said that + 从句，从句中用一般将来时 will reopen。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 她昨天请技术员修了电脑。
exercises.explanation: 使役结构 have + 宾语 + 过去分词，由技术员执行，所以用 by 引出执行者。
